_comment: Tiers whose weapons are obtained through a host mod's own ritual/forge system instead of a
crafting bench. A tier listed here gets NO shaped recipe and NO unlock advancement - the
ritual is the only way to get it, which is the whole point.
Forbidden Arcanus' Draco Arcanus gear comes out of a tier-2 Hephaestus Forge ritual that
transmutes the netherite version of the same item, so ours transmutes Simply Swords'
netherite weapon of the same shape - simplyswords:netherite_longsword -> our Draco Arcanus
longsword. Simply Swords is a required dependency, so that input always exists.
Every cost below is lifted straight from one of Forbidden Arcanus' own four Draco Arcanus
armour rituals - nothing is invented. Their costs scale with the armour slot; ours scale with
weapon weight instead, using Simply Swords' damage classes:
Retune here if it plays wrong - the generator reads these numbers, nothing is hardcoded.
